svg.title: Shiroi Youso — Confluence of Five. Draft 2 / Shiroi Youso bloodline-keyed classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Fivefold Kindling forks into Pale Lightning then Divine Convergence, or Charred Current then White Immolation. Bedrock and Tide forks into Gale Bulwark then Eye of the Tempest, or Tidal Mending then Pull of the Undertow. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Shiroi Youso jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

Undertow"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: root Fivefold Kindling (+2 self Increase Damage Given, +2 exposure) forks into a Damage route (Pale Lightning \u2192 Divine Convergence) and an Afterburn route (Charred Current \u2192 White Immolation). Root Bedrock and Tide (+2 self Decrease Damage Taken, +2 Heal) forks into a DDT route (Gale Bulwark \u2192 Eye of the Tempest) and a sustain route ending in exposure (Tidal Mending \u2192 Pull of the Undertow). 2/4/4 nodes; every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP against the 4 BP cap.","Flats scaled by coverage. Every percentage tag reaches two rows, so each takes the two-row ladder: IDG +2/+3 (max +5, 40%), IDT +2/+2/+4 (max +6, 41%), DDT +2/+3/+2 (max +7, 42%). Afterburn +3/+4 (max +7: 42% and 37%) stays under the single-row +10 because Lightning Release 35% and Element Divine 30% already saturate the 60% per-hit cap together. Damage reaches two rows (40, 45), not Taiyo Kami's three, so it carries +2/+4 (max +6, the guardrail). Heal +2/+3 (max +5: +50 HP per tick on 250).","Capstone secondaries never out-bid a sibling Hidden Art on its own tag: White Immolation's +2 exposure and Pull of the Undertow's +2 DDT sit below Gale Bulwark's +3; Eye of the Tempest's +3 self buff has no Hidden Art competitor. Row-weighted node values: Foundations 8/6, Hidden Arts 4/6/6/3, Advanced Arts 8/12/10/12; full builds 21\u201332 against Taiyo Kami's 20\u201331 on nine rows. Maxima: Damage +6, IDG +5, IDT +6, DDT +7, Afterburn +7, Heal +5; not jointly attainable.","Main tree and passives: the IDG and IDT rows list the five elements with no stat filter, so (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73) they multiply five-element damage only: the kit's two Damage rows, the five injected children and any other five-element hit; element-less damage (basic attacks, non-elemental jutsu, element-less weapons) gets ratio 0. The DDT rows list all four stat types, no element: every non-pierce hit. The five-element IDG passive (25% + 0.15/level) stacks on top as a bloodline multiplier.","Delivery and uptime: all six casts are cooldown 7; Lightning Release and Element Divine cost 60 AP, the rest 40. Wind Release's DDT/IDG and Earth Release's DDT are SELF rows realized on the caster at cast time whatever the ground target (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a74b); only the unsupported INHERIT rows (Wind's move, Earth's barrier) become ground effects. Water Release's heal is a 2-round effect on the caster, paid on the two following rounds. Fire Release carries a self buff and an exposure.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Bedrock and Tide or Charred Current; Burn pressure Bedrock and Tide or Pale Lightning; Fortified Fivefold Kindling or Tidal Mending; Control Fivefold Kindling or Gale Bulwark. Tidal Mending (+30 HP per tick on the single heal row) is the lowest row-weighted node (3 vs siblings 4/6/6), a gate to Pull of the Undertow. User-owned: (a) keep as a deliberate gate; (b) shift +1 Heal from Bedrock and Tide to it (+1/+4); (c) add a small second tag off the DDT lane."],"risks":["Ally hazard: Element Divine row 1 (Afterburn 30%) and row 2 (exposure 35%) are AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN with friendly fire none (=ALL): allies inside the circle also receive the debuffs; the caster never does (OTHER_USER target, SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a74b). Kindling, Charred Current, White Immolation and Pull of the Undertow raise what allies there take; positioning decides. The Damage row is ENEMIES-only.","Afterburn saturation: Lightning Release 35% and Element Divine 30% stack to 65% on one target, above the 60% per-hit cap, so the +7 route adds value only while a single Afterburn source is active. Downstream coverage (every non-pierce hit by anyone for 2 rounds, including the injected children cast into Lightning Release's 2-round stun) was not simulated; pierce hits take no Afterburn.","Leakage: with five-element IDG/IDT rows, the +5 self buff and +6 exposure reach only five-element damage: the player's other five-element jutsu (IDG) and anyone's five-element hits on the exposed target, allies included (IDT). Basic attacks, element-less weapons and non-elemental jutsu get ratio 0. Fire and Wind windows overlap to 80% self buff; Fire plus Element Divine exposures to 82%.","Delivery: Wind Release rows 0-1 and Earth Release row 0 are SELF rows on EMPTY_GROUND casts; Water Release's heal is INHERIT on a SELF-target cast: all four land on the caster at cast time, not positionally (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a74b). Their cost is the forgone Damage/Afterburn routes; Eye of the Tempest holds both DDT (42%) and IDG (40%) maxima unconditionally: user-owned check (IDG +3 \u2192 +2?).","Injected children: Lightning, Fire and Water Release inject five SPECIAL children (empty bloodlineId; level = inject power 100/110) with Damage, DDG, IDG, Lifesteal and IDT rows. Inheritance is a gap-register decision; this tree counts none of them. If they inherit, Damage +6 reaches five more hits, IDG +5 Voltari's IDG row, IDT +6 Rising Water Slicer's IDT row; Lifesteal/DDG stay untargeted.","Classification: Fire and Lightning both sit on Damage rows; neither isolates the kit (5 of 11 rows match either, 5 fall back to None). Collisions: Primal Radiance (INCLUDE) on Fire damage rows, Voltara Divine (INCLUDE) on Lightning damage rows; only the excluded non-public Youso Shiroi carries both. The bloodline-keyed label needs the classification extension; normal-jutsu collision unverified.","Heal scale: one static row, 25 power = 250 HP per tick on two following rounds; the +5 route adds 100 HP per 40 AP cast, small against high-level pools. Tidal Mending's value rests entirely on that cast, and Increase Heal is absent from the kit, so no node compounds it. Absorb (Water) and barrier (Earth) are unsupported and unchanged.","Context: skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in ranked PvP and ranked sparring; normal-tree potency policy is not approved, so a combined stacking audit precedes implementation. Lightning Release and Element Divine carry Damage and Afterburn and are touched by both offensive routes: the load-bearing casts. No combat simulation was performed; balance values remain user-owned."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":6,"decreasedamagetaken":7,"afterburn":7,"heal":5},"supported_rows_in_kit":11,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"afterburn":2,"damage":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"heal":1,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["afterburn","damage","decreasedamagetaken","heal","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 2 / Shiroi Youso bloodline-keyed classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Shiroi Youso jutsu inherit Shiroi Youso potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. g.text: Draft 2 / Shiroi Youso bloodline-keyed classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Shiroi Youso jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Divine Convergence path + Bedrock and Tide
White Immolation path + Bedrock and Tide
Eye of the Tempest path + Fivefold Kindling
Pull of the Undertow path + Fivefold Kindling
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Heal additions are raw power: each +1 Heal power is +10 HP per tick of a static heal.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
